full_prompt_en: A dynamic full-color shonen manga illustration shows four young adventurers racing through a ruined fantasy town. The central figure lunges toward the viewer with a clenched fist enlarged by perspective, spiky dark blue hair, a striped scarf, and a sleeveless navy outfit edged in gold. Two companions flank him: a blond girl in a short burgundy dress on the left and a brown-haired girl in a dark outfit on the right. A fourth figure with spiky golden hair and a flowing red cape follows slightly behind. Their large expressive eyes and sharply angled brows communicate confidence and motion. The viewer looks down at them from a slightly elevated, close viewpoint; the central fist and bent knee project toward the lower edge, while the three others form a broad arc behind. Broken masonry, tilted timber, and pale dusty streets fill the background with an intricate but lower-contrast texture. Clean black contour lines define faces, hair spikes, scarves, and clothing folds, while dense short marks and warm washes build the debris. The palette combines muted tan and stone gray surroundings with concentrated navy blue, burgundy red, gold, and warm skin. Light is clear and diffuse, making every character readable without one dramatic shadow. Flowing hair, cape, and diagonal limbs create a strong forward rhythm. The image feels adventurous, exuberant, and immediately legible even within its crowded environment.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅动感全彩少年漫画插画呈现四位年轻冒险者冲过废墟中的幻想城镇。中央人物握拳向观者扑来，拳头被透视放大，深蓝刺发，围条纹围巾，穿金边无袖藏蓝衣。两位同伴在侧：左边是穿短酒红裙的金发女孩，右边是穿深衣的棕发女孩。第四人有金色刺发和飘扬红披风，略跟在后。大而富表情的眼与锐角眉传达自信和运动。观者从略高且近的位置看他们；中央拳与弯膝向下缘冲出，另外三人在身后形成宽弧。破石、倾斜木材和浅色蒙尘街道以繁复但低对比纹理填背景。干净黑轮廓界定脸、发尖、围巾和衣褶，密短笔与暖罩染建立瓦砾。配色将暗棕和石灰环境与集中藏蓝、酒红、金及暖肤色结合。光清楚漫散，让每个角色可读，无需一处戏剧暗影。飘发、披风和斜向肢体建立强前冲节奏。画面冒险、兴奋，即使环境拥挤也能立即读懂。
style_prompt_en: Full-color shonen manga illustration combines crisp black contour, expressive angular shapes, and strong foreshortened movement. Large near forms overlap a loose arc of smaller forms, with diagonal gestures and flowing bands creating forward momentum. Concentrated navy, burgundy, gold, and warm flesh tones separate the focal cluster from a lower-contrast tan-gray field. Faces and important edges stay clean and sharp; secondary surroundings are rendered with many short textured marks and dusty washes. Smooth color areas in focal forms contrast with granular background detail. Lighting is broadly clear rather than theatrical, so shape hierarchy and color placement carry the action. Hair-like spikes, cloth-like curves, and angular fragments alternate in a lively rhythm. The result is energetic, adventurous, and highly readable, with expressive exaggeration supported by careful spatial layering.
style_prompt_zh: 全彩少年漫画插画结合清晰黑轮廓、富表情角形和强透视缩短的运动。近处大形叠在较小形的松弧之前，斜手势与飘动带创造向前动势。集中藏蓝、酒红、金和暖肤色把焦点簇群从低反差黄棕灰场中分出。脸与重要边缘保持干净锐利，次要周围由许多短纹笔痕与蒙尘罩染完成。焦点形的平滑色面对比颗粒背景细节。光整体清楚而非戏剧化，因此形层级与颜色安置承载动作。刺状形、布般曲线与角形碎片活泼交替。结果充满能量、冒险且高度可读，富表情夸张由谨慎空间层叠支撑。
theme_en: Four young adventurers rush forward through a ruined fantasy town
theme_zh: 四位年轻冒险者冲过废墟中的幻想城镇
name: Hiro Mashima
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
